Documentation overview

This site documents the Full Width Pics static landing-page template in paulweezydesign/f. It is not documentation for a backend service or a separate application.

Source and build workflow

Edit Pug pages, SCSS styles, JavaScript, and assets under src/ . The build generates publishable HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets under dist/ . Generated files are tracked in this repository, but rebuilding replaces direct edits to them. 

npm ci
npm run build

Choose a guide

  • Getting started : install dependencies, preview locally, and create the publishable output.
  • API reference : understand the available build commands and source/output interfaces; there is no public application API.
  • Configuration : customize content, styles, metadata, and assets in their source files.
  • Security : review what goes into a publicly served static site and how to work with the development tools.
  • Migration : move direct output edits back into maintained source without inventing release history.

Publish the generated site

Publish the entire dist/ directory to your static host, preserving its directory structure. The documentation entry is docs/index.html within that output. Documentation links are relative, so they do not require a particular hostname or root path.

Hosting-account setup and automatic deployment are not included in this repository. Preview the generated files before replacing an existing deployment.
